answer: In PoA, each interaction updates an EigenTrust-style matrix, while reputation undergoes exponential temporal decay with a defined half-life. A freshly spawned sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality and must sustain honest, reciprocated service to gain weight; a cluster cannot forge influence through self-ratings because weak external support keeps its mass negligible, whether identities are called violet or lotus, preventing them from passing consensus.
